name: SDSS J0100+1818 (Hubble)
blurb: SDSS J0100+1818, an ultra-massive elliptical galaxy acting as a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: sdssj01001818-hubble
story: An ultra-massive elliptical galaxy bends the light of more distant galaxies behind it. Around it, three background sources appear as ten separate images.

claims.text: The HST program 15253 target CSWA15 lies at RA 01 00 49.19, Dec +18 18 27.70, redshift 0.581, observed in F438W and F160W
SDSS J0100+1818 was imaged by HST program GO-15253 in F438W and F160W
SDSS J0100+1818 is an ultra-massive elliptical (early-type) galaxy
SDSS J0100+1818 is surrounded by ten multiple images of three background sources
It was called CSWA 15 when first targeted and is now identified as CSWA 115 in the CASSOWARY catalog
